latest_release.name: v3.0.6
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(answer-utils): stop text logic matching unanswered fields by @RaphaelFakhri in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/352
* fix(answer-utils): accept negative numbers when no min is set by @y9ndra in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/354
* fix(webapp): scroll multi-select dropdown options instead of overflowing by @RafaelJaime in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/360
* feat: reply-to, respondent subject and owner skip notification options by @RafaelJaime in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/361
* feat(integrations): page apps, starting with Privatus Analytics by @ja-andrews in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/362
* fix(server): clear the form analytics cache on each visit and submission by @iMuFeng in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/366
* fix(answer-utils): let respondents submit forms with a file attached by @gruffvaughan in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/371
* fix(form-renderer): make progress reflect the respondent's route by @gruffvaughan in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/373
* fix(webapp): use the themed select for "Next question" in logic by @yuyongyan29-dev in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/380
* refactor: switch the Nest builder to SWC for faster builds by @iMuFeng in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/383
* fix(upload): send signatures as named files instead of anonymous blobs by @xwxfox in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/382

## New Contributors
* @RaphaelFakhri made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/352
* @y9ndra made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/354
* @ja-andrews made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/362
* @yuyongyan29-dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/380
* @xwxfox made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/382

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/heyform/heyform/compare/v3.0.5...v3.0.6
